scope: Claim-specific assessment of the 18 central and 33 numerical cases at the tested grids, steps, seeds and fixed coordinate scaffolds.
predeclared_rule_applied: Persistent shifts require another level and/or revised figure interpretation. All flagged original configurations have seeds 0, 1 and 2. The coupled entry check supplies an additional transport-step comparison. Persistent shifts are retained and affected claims revised, with no tolerance or scientific input changed.
reporting_resolution: Finite-configuration descriptive comparisons and explicit numerical sensitivity replace invariant curve order, grid-independent residual predictions and exposure/access convergence claims. Central comparison of both ratios and all representations is preserved.
unresolved_numerical_properties: Asymptotic convergence, convergence order and continuum error bounds are not established.
The separate contributions of spatial discretization, stochastic divergence and coupled dynamics to each observed difference are not isolated.
The numerical sensitivity of the nine kinetic alternatives is not known before they are run; the baseline screen is not an error bound for those alternatives.
kinetic_reporting_conditions: Run only the nine already prepared cases, keeping all inputs and comparison controls fixed.
Describe the results as one-factor challenges of the configured model at TE2 seed 0; retain all signs, zeros and failures.
Report full trajectories, normalized integrals, composition and spatial access against the paired baseline and descriptive baseline N3 range.
Compare observed changes with the completed numerical screens without treating their ranges as confidence intervals or transferable error bars.

Do not interpret a kinetic contrast as resolution-invariant or calibrated biology. A new material conclusion that relies on a marginal sign or unresolved discretization interaction requires targeted review and, if needed, a specifically justified additional check.
No final adequacy, parameter calibration or publication approval follows from permission to generate these checks.
